contexts.text: Grief that the scientifics should be destroyed which he had imbibed with delight and deliciousnesses.
The living soul that creepeth = their delights.
Worldly things... delight the genius; spiritual things... delight the mind.
These things delight their minds more than their eyes. HH 186:end.
To delight himself splendidly every day () = their delight that they had and read the Word.
Delights delight the thoughts, and take away reflections.

Occasions of social intercourse, which exhilarate the minds of the Angels, delight their dispositions, delight their bosoms, and recreate their bodies... From these (uses) is the soul and life in all their gladnesses and delights.
They delight themselves foolishly as with the possession of the universe.
Our visionary delight comes on us by alternations...
Their greatest delight is to punish; wherefore from the general company of the malignant there flows such a delight from cupidity into fewer; and thus into those who treat him badly...
They said that it was on account of their delight at the sight of money...
Should they die before their eyes, they hence derive delight.
Their delight is such, that they feel the mere delight.
With such delight are they affected, that their delight from such things surpasses every other delight.
